acceptanceCriteria: A corvint tests subcommand or lint rule emits ACTOR-UNAUTHORIZED findings, EXEMPT and UNKNOWN (with closed reason) results as deterministic JSON
A CLI test runs the issue #1115 repro fixture end to end
The TSA spec records the CLI surface
body: Residual of V1-1770 (PR #1121, GitHub #1115), which delivered the ACTOR-UNAUTHORIZED analysis in internal/testsource/actor_auth*.go for Rails + CanCanCan with Playwright request.<verb>(literal path). Expected: an agent can run the analysis (e.g. `corvint tests actor-auth` or as a `corvint tests lint` rule) and get findings/UNKNOWN reasons as JSON. Actual: testsource.ActorAuthorization is a library only; the CLI was deferred to avoid cmd/corvint/tests.go conflicts with PR #1096 (TSA-V0 scope note).
title: Expose the ACTOR-UNAUTHORIZED actor-authorization analysis through a corvint tests CLI
